title: Mankind’S Mission On Earth: To Act On Behalf Of Our Lord
body:
Audhu bi-llahi mina shaitanir rajim,
Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim,
la haula wa la quwatta illa bi-llahi-l ‘Aliyu-l ‘Azim...
la haula wa la quwatta illa bi-llahi-l ‘Aliyu-l ‘Azim.
As-salamu alaikum! Meded, ya Sultanu-l Anbiya, Meded, ya Sultanu-l Awliya, Meded, ya
Sahibu Zaman!
We are in a holy month. It is the holiest month through year: Shahru Ramadan, Ramadan Mubarak. We are
thanking to Allah Almighty, saying: Ya Rabbi, laka-l hamd wa shukr! - that You are making us to reach to this
holy month once again. So many people they were with ourselves last year; last year they were with us, this
year they are not - taken away. Kulli shay yarju ila aslihi - Everything going to come back to its own
personality or origin. Everything must come back to their origin; that is an unchangeable wisdom, an
unchangeable Allah Almighty’s Order.
There is a saying: Everything on earth it is earth. Kulli shay a 'ala turab turabun. This, our Dunya, our world,
you are looking and seeing so many things over it: plants, animals, and mankind. You are saying: “This is a
tree, it is not a piece of land, no, it is tree. That is an animal; that is a man. How you are saying that
everything over this planet is from it, (and it is) going to be as before?” As before (means: to be) nothing on
this world, and the Creator He arranged this world among so many hundreds, thousands, millions and
billions stars and galaxies. He chose this planet to be our homeland, prepared on it everything and then
landed Sayiddina Adam, because he was appointed and granted from the Lord of Heavens to be on this land
Khalifa, our Lord’s deputy. Therefore He prepared this land and finally He sent His Khalifa. Yes, he was
created in Paradise and he was in Paradise, but Allah Almighty was saying to the Angels that: “I am going to
bring in creation a new creature that he should be My deputy.” That means: when Allah Almighty (was)

saying this, the Angels they were saying: “O our Lord, why You are creating a deputy, a new creature that they
are going to do so many things on earth that we are not happy with that actions from that new creature?” And
Allah was saying: “I know! What you are knowing, I know it. You don’t know! You are knowing something, I
know everything! You know that point from that new creature, (that) they should be trouble makers, fighters,
killing, and destroying and doing so many disliked things, but yet I know about them more than you, because
I am: ‘ â˜ala ya’lamu ma khalaq’ - I am the Creator! Keep your Adab, I know what I just created! You are
knowing this, something, something else”, Allah Almighty was saying.
Yes, and in Paradise he and Eve (Hawwa) were there and the earth (was) here, (he) that he was appointed to
be on earth Khalifa, Khalifatullah, deputy of Allah Almighty. And then Allah Almighty (was) preparing
reasons that it was going to be a way or wasila (for Adam and Hawwa) to come on earth, to be landed.
Therefore so many things happened and finally Adam and Eve they have been landed on earth. They came
here to be king on earth, to make everything for His Honour, to act on earth on behalf of Allah.
That is your mission! Everyone (is) just granted that honour that he must do everything on behalf of his Lord
Allah Almighty! What we are thinking? Mankind, where they are now? Mankind now they are knowing their
missions? No! Who (is) knowing? No one (is) knowing, no one (is) saying this point. No one (is) saying that:
“Our mission (is) to act on behalf of our Creator, our Lord Allah Almighty.” Our mission! Where are our
governments, where are our leaders? Where are our universities, where are our teachers, schools, where they
are? What they are teaching? It was the first point to be taught to our small ones: for what they have been
created and by whom they are created! They are teaching (this)?
I was in New York perhaps ten years ago and they were taking me to UN center. There was a (plastic) pistol
perhaps bigger than me and a handkerchief tying (it around) also. Ma sha Allah! That means: they are
stopping pistols, tying, (so) that (there are) no more wars on earth. O drunk people! It is written for them that
fighting - you can stop it? They never stop!
I was entering, looking around, I was praying Dhuhr prayer. But some of our brothers - including Raja
Ashman, Allah bless him also- a group (was) coming later and they were asking me: “We can do our praying
here?” I said to them: “Okay, yes, you can do, what is the matter? (It is) a free place, go and pray.” They were
beginning and (suddenly there was) coming (one person, big) like a North Pole bear, running and shouting:

“You can’t pray here because from this entrance Allah (is) never getting in!” There was coming such 5, 7
bears, running and saying: “You can’t pray here! No Allah here!” I am witness! I am saying: O my Lord, make
this Dunya to fall on them!
Do you think that they are doing anything for the benefit of mankind (in that center)? Never! But they are
always doing everything for the benefit of Shaitan! Perhaps 2oo and more governments (gather) there,
nations coming, including our heedless Muslim countries, also they are coming and attending there. I am
very angry with them that they are going into such a place that they are against their Lord, no respect for
their Lord, no saying: “Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim”! They are shouting, they are quarrelling, therefore
(there is) no any good result. That is the center of Shaitans, the center of Diabolo, the center of Sadanas! For
the sake of Sadanas they are going there!
And I am making this (Dua) on them, coming back, never getting in. I am getting out, I am saying: “Not to
come on ourselves that building.” Perhaps one day (it may happen). Instead to be destroyed that two
buildings - but Shaitan is keeping its center! - that_ center must be destroyed! I hope that mankind they are
not doing this, from another world - that they are saying some worlds there is someone there - they should
send (something) on that center, UN center, to destroy (it), (and to make) all of them downstairs! And I am
making two Rakat Shukr, when they are destroying (it), all of them under it, shouting like Karun!
Lahsa! After (an) eclipse there is (always) some slap! Just two, three seconds (and) one hundred thousand
people (are) under ruins now. After an eclipse (there) must be something! And also war coming! Now
mankind, they (are) never going to find the ways (like) in the days that passed!...
They are not teaching, no! Now (it is) beginning, who is … Beginning from trees, getting trees yellow, leaves
(are) coming down; they should fall down, one after one! They are not teaching! No Allah? No God? Allah
should show them, if He is the Creator, the Lord, or not!
Our mission (is): to act on behalf of our Lord on this planet, nothing else. Anyone (is) saying (this)? From
Bishops, from Rabbis, from Hindus, from Buddhists- which one can object on my point that I am saying:
mankind’s mission on earth to act on behalf of their Lord, nothing else, or this world (is) going to be
destroyed - from East to West, from West to East and finishing. (It is) stamped. You understand what I am
saying or sleeping?... Understanding?... No? Where is my stick?... Not understanding yet?... Look! The first

understanding person is sitting next to me! What we shall say?...
And Allah Almighty (was) saying for His Prophet: “You are only Mudhakkir fa dhakkir! You must remind My
people on earth, because they are forgetting. Remind them that, what I am saying; only remind everyone
what is their missions.”
That is my mission also - on that mission. It is holy month and our mission now (is) to keep the special
Orders that He (Almighty) specialized this holy month by fasting and prayer. Keep your prayers! And we are
asking and saying to you that: Keep your Lord’s Order and fast and keep you Lord’s Order and make Sajdah!
Keep your positions in His divine Presence, not to be kicked down!
O people, come to reality and accept it! You must accept reality, because people (are) running away from
reality, because they are drunk. Drunk! Leave to be drunk, come and accept truth! What is truth? Truth, only
with true ones you can find it! We are not asking jewels from grocery shop, no, grocery shop never selling
jewels. (And also) you can’t ask tomato and potato and cabbage from jewellery shop. Truth, most precious
thing on earth, you are asking from grocery shop? No. Truth just granted to Prophet a.s. and the last one, the
Seal of Prophets, the honour of whole creation, Sayiddina Muhammad sws. He had been granted whole
treasures on earth and on Heavens. He had and then, after him, (those) whom they are on his steps; they are
only true ones. True ones.
Once the son of Sayiddina Omar, Allah bless them, Sayiddina Abdullah ibn Omar, he was on his way to Hijaz,
to Mecca Mukarrama with caravan. They were moving, he was with this caravan’s people. They reached to a
place, then the way was going like this (there was a) diversion; (the) camels (were) on their ways (the) way
coming like this… and Sayiddina Abdullah ibn Omar (was) going like this and coming like that and going on.
They said to him: “O Sayyidina ibn Omar, why you are following this way and leaving caravan’s way here?”
He said: “(Once) I was with Prophet sws on this way and when he came here, he came in such a way, turning
like this and making on that way. Therefore I like to follow his steps.” And really, where he (the Prophet had)
put his steps, yet that Nur, that Lights, (was) getting up. But people they are blind. They are not looking and
seeing that Nur. Sayiddina Ibn Omar, he said that, only this, but he was looking and seeing (that) where the
Prophet was putting his step, there was coming Nur, Light!

They are true ones! If you are asking truth, you must ask from those people! You can’t find it easily; as Ruby
or Diamond or Pearl you can’t find easily, such people, it is not easy to be found. You must look; you must try
to find them. Difficult, but: Talabana wajadana, who is asking, (is) going to find. Therefore - truth you may
find through true ones. Ask, (and) you can find! If you can find it, you have been saved!... You have been
saved.
May Allah forgive me and bless you and make yourselves to keep His holy Orders and to be on our real
mission, to be happy here and Hereafter, to be blessed ones. For the honour of the most honoured one,
Sayiddina Muhammad sws.
Fatiha.
Lefke, 16.10.2005 Transcribed by Khairiyah Siegel
